# Awesome AI Coding Tools (Canonical Catalog)
> Curated 3-tier taxonomy of AI coding assistants, autonomous agents, local foundation models, MCP servers, and empirical SWE-bench research.
> Canonical URL: https://github.com/mahmoudsajjadi/awesome-ai-coding-tools
> Web App & VRAM Calculator: https://mahmoudsajjadi.github.io/awesome-ai-coding-tools/

## Taxonomy Overview
- Level 1 (Beginner): Zero-setup agentic IDEs and in-editor autocomplete (Cursor, Windsurf, Google Antigravity, Google Jules, Trae, PearAI, Zed, Continue.dev, Codeium).
- Level 2 (Intermediate): Git-integrated CLI pair programmers, parallel agent orchestrators, local execution stacks, and Model Context Protocol servers (Claude Code, Aider, Cline, OpenCode, Roo Code, Goose, Ollama, vLLM, llama.cpp, Qwen2.5-Coder, Devstral, DeepSeek-V3/R1).
- Level 3 (Expert): Autonomous software engineers and empirical research (SWE-bench Verified leaderboard, SWE-agent, OpenHands, Tree-sitter AST PageRank repo-maps, and unified diff vs search/replace edit formats).
